title: Abandoned Utility Halls
physical_identity: Infinite Euclidean maze of cramped chalky concrete maintenance tunnels turning at 45 degrees, lined with non-cooperating pipes and machinery and many coded doors.
scale_topology: Infinite indoor tunnel array; side rooms and void rooms behind doors; Office Space EL3A inside it.
anomalies: Series-wired lights black out 3x3 to 6x6 grids
Infinite lightless void rooms behind doors
lighting_sound: Sparse buzzing fluorescents (white or orange), uneven; machines only whir; violet emergency lights in blackout areas.
